english.note: Use 注碼 for the money or value put up in a bet, rather than a business share or physical post.

examples.english: The stake I put on this game isn’t big, so I won’t feel too bad if I lose.
examples.traditional: 今場波我落嘅注碼唔大，輸咗都唔會肉赤。
